load_R2N2_dataset: load an R2N2 dataset with voxels and camera parameters for a given train or test split
collate_batched_R2N2: collate a batch of R2N2 samples into padded meshes, images, and voxel tensors for DataLoader
render_R2N2_by_idxs: render R2N2 3D models by dataset indices using FoVPerspectiveCameras and RasterizationSettings
render_R2N2_by_model_ids: render R2N2 3D models by their model IDs with custom cameras and point lights
render_cubified_voxels: render a mesh from R2N2 voxel data and compare the output image to a reference
